quiz.explanation: Optic nerve (II). Retinal ganglion cell axons form CN II.

quiz.prompt: Which nerve supplies most eye muscles and pupillary constriction?
quiz.explanation: Oculomotor nerve (III). LR6, SO4, all the other extraocular muscles III.
Trochlear nerve (IV). The only cranial nerve to emerge dorsally from the brainstem.

quiz.prompt: Which nerve carries facial sensation and supplies mastication?
quiz.explanation: Trigeminal nerve (V). V1 and V2 sensory; V3 mixed.

quiz.prompt: Which nerve abducts the eye through lateral rectus?
quiz.explanation: Abducens nerve (VI). A VI lesion weakens abduction.

quiz.prompt: Which nerve supplies facial expression and anterior tongue taste?
quiz.explanation: Facial nerve (VII). Taste travels with chorda tympani; parotid secretion belongs to IX.

quiz.prompt: Which nerve carries hearing and balance?
quiz.explanation: Vestibulocochlear nerve (VIII). Vestibular = balance; cochlear = hearing.

quiz.prompt: Which nerve carries the classical afferent gag limb?
quiz.explanation: Glossopharyngeal nerve (IX). IX afferent, X efferent.

quiz.prompt: Which nerve carries the classical efferent gag limb?
quiz.explanation: Vagus nerve (X). IX afferent, X efferent.

quiz.prompt: Which nerve supplies SCM and trapezius?
quiz.explanation: Accessory nerve (XI). Spinal XI is the neck/shoulder motor nerve.

quiz.prompt: Which nerve moves the tongue (except palatoglossus)?
quiz.explanation: Hypoglossal nerve (XII). A lower motor XII lesion can deviate the protruded tongue toward the weak side.
